original_target.title: Villani’s convex-injectivity-domain conjecture
original_target.outcome: Claim: affirmative convex injectivity domains under weak MTW

answer: Affirmative convexity under weak MTW with focal cut points allowed.
required_status_qualification: Complete resolution of the stated target in the cited source.
scope_comparison: The current actual PDF Theorem1.1 claims ordinary linear convexity of I(x) on every smooth connected compact boundaryless Riemannian manifold of dimension>=2, under exactly orthogonal-pair weak MTW. Equation(1.1) is the same open minimizing-beyond-time-one domain and(1.2) the same -3/2 mixed fourth derivative convention. The paper explicitly excludes extra nonfocality or prior convexity premises and allows conjugate cut points. Dimension1, if included locally, has interval injectivity domains directly.
